purpose: Teach: リュック/コスメ/さんま/琵琶湖/ライトアップ/待ち遠しい/リベンジ/新居

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行、リュック、軽量タイプにしたいな。
lines.en: I want to get a lightweight backpack for the school trip.
lines.style: Conversational and matter-of-fact. Slight upward tilt at the end as she brings up what she's been thinking about. Natural teen pacing, no affectation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。妹、コスメ買うようになったよ。
lines.en: Yeah. My sister's gotten really into buying cosmetics lately.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Soft delivery on 'cosmetics' — noticing something about her that he's processing. Not judgmental, just... aware.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 秋、給食のさんま、楽しみ。
lines.en: The mackerel pike at school lunch in autumn is something I really look forward to.
lines.style: Sudden brightness breaks through. A small genuine smile in her voice. She's not performing enthusiasm — she actually means this. Quick, warm delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 地理で、琵琶湖、習ったよ。
lines.en: We learned about Lake Biwa in geography the other day.
lines.style: Casual mention, like he's offering a small fact he just remembered. Understated. No urgency, just sharing something that crossed his mind.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クリスマス、駅前のライトアップ、綺麗だよね。
lines.en: The Christmas light display at the station front is so pretty, don't you think?
lines.style: Engaged and present. She's painting the image as she speaks — slightly faster pace on 'light display.' Genuine warmth, not performative. Checking in with him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 冬休み、待ち遠しいよな。
lines.en: Winter break feels like it can't come soon enough.
lines.style: Soft wistfulness. A slight exhale on 'can't come soon enough' — the kind of thing you say half to yourself. Longing without complaint. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 前回の模試、リベンジ、絶対する!
lines.en: I'm definitely going to retake the last mock exam and do better.
lines.style: Sudden shift to quiet determination. Firm conviction on 'definitely' without being aggressive. She's made a decision and she's telling him. Steady, resolved.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いとこ、新居、招待してくれた。
lines.en: My cousin invited me to see their new place.
lines.style: Lightness at the end — genuine warmth about something good that's happening. Quick and uncomplicated. A small genuine smile closing out the exchange.
